profile.headline: Roving Dutchmen
profile.summary:
I've worked as a Software Engineer, Architect, Site Reliability Engineer, and Unix Systems Administrator. My current focus tends towards C++ backend development of distributed large-scale systems. I greatly enjoy developing software, and enjoy even more keeping said software reliable and available.

Specialties: C++, Distributed Systems, Backend Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer, focused on increasing the reliability, maintainability, capabilities and scalability of pipelines processing satellite, aerial, and street-level image and pose data.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Scalability · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: A year of nomadic life, traveling around the USA in a 5th wheel RV with my family, exploring nature.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development, with focuses on scalability, reliability, monitoring and maintainability of production systems.

Projects /   Teams: (newest to oldest)

  - Software Engineering with an infrastructure-focus, for the Visual Positioning Service (Google Maps' Live View backend, Tango before that)
  - Software Engineering Tech Lead for Google Transit Directions & Real-Time Updates Backend Systems
  - Site Reliability Engineering Tech Lead for the entire Geo product area
  - Site Reliability Engineering Tech Lead for the company-wide Production Monitoring Infrastructure
  - Site Reliability Engineering Tech Lead for the Billing system
  - Software Engineer for the Billing System
